note: Mandiant's February 2013 "APT1" report states that WEBC2 backdoors -- APT1's best-known backdoor family, whose older versions retrieved commands hidden between HTML comment tags on a webpage fetched from a C2 server -- are "the reason why some security companies refer to APT1 as the Comment Crew." Mandiant documented the technique behind the name rather than coining the name itself. "Comment Panda" and "Comment Group" are other vendors' variants of the same name.
iSight Partners named this group "Sandworm" in October 2014 after finding multiple references to Frank Herbert's science-fiction Dune novels in the group's malware code.
